title: Anna's Shopping Day
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Monday. She has a shopping list in her hand. The list has milk, eggs, bread, and apples. She takes a basket and starts to look for the things.

Anna finds the milk first. Then she gets the eggs and the bread. She does not find the apples, so she asks the shop man for help. He shows her the apples near the door. Now Anna has everything on her list.

questions.text: What is on Anna's shopping list?

How does Anna probably feel at the end of the story?
options: Happy, because she has everything on her list
Angry, because the shop is closed
Sad, because she lost her money
Confused, because she has no list

paragraph_translations: Anna pazartesi günü dükkana gider. Elinde bir alışveriş listesi vardır. Listede süt, yumurta, ekmek ve elma vardır. Sepeti alır ve eşyaları aramaya başlar.
Anna önce sütü bulur. Sonra yumurtayı ve ekmeği alır. Elmaları bulamaz, bu yüzden dükkan çalışanından yardım ister. O, elmaları kapının yanında gösterir. Şimdi Anna'nın listesindeki her şey vardır.
